correctness.rationale: In a connected graph, every nonfixed 3-periodic GHM state must cycle all vertices through 0,1,2; any permanently zero vertex adjacent to a cycling vertex would be excited, a contradiction. This is equivalent to each initial vertex seeing a successor-color neighbor. The 27 normalized ordered-rung states, open-boundary vectors and transition M count each coloring with global color shift factor three. Independently reconstructed all 27 entries and verified the componentwise exact identity M^3 b=4M²b-Mb-2b, plus 3a[b,Mb,M²b,M³b]=[0,6,24,90]. Independently applied three literal GH updates to all ternary configurations on open ladders n=2..6; counts 0,6,24,90,324. Thus the unbounded recurrence follows from a complete finite matrix identity, not sample extrapolation.
residual_risks: The original finite checks only cover n<=6, but the 27-component matrix identity proves the recurrence for every n.
